cookie_learn_more: If you want to learn more about cookies and our use of cookies in connection with Shopee’s services, visit our {terms} anytime.
cookie_general_description:
We use cookies and similar tools (collectively referred to as "cookies") for the purposes described below. For each of the following purposes, you can choose to activate the cookies by checking the switch of the related slider.
Please note that, unless you are logged in, your choices will only be effective on the web browser and device that you are currently using.
essential_cookie_description: Essential to make our Platform usable by enabling basic functions such as page navigation and access to secure areas of our Platform. The use of these cookies does not require your consent.
analytical_cookie_description: Collect technical information about your visit and interactions with the platform in order to understand your use of the services and improve your user experience.
functional_cookie_description: Enable certain Platform functions, collect information about your activities, and remember certain preferences and settings you specify on the platform.
advertising_cookie_description: Collect information about your activity on the site or browsing activity to present content more relevant to you and your interests.
social_media_cookie_description: Collect information about your social media interactions with our website.
cookie_general_description_non_br: Kami menggunakan cookies dan sejenisnya untuk tujuan yang dijelaskan di bawah ini. Untuk setiap tujuan berikut, kamu bisa aktifkan cookies dengan klik tombol yang tersedia.
